companyOverview.name: HubSpot

painPoints.title: Lead Qualification Inefficiency
painPoints.why: Manual lead scoring leads to missed opportunities.
painPoints.impact: Lower conversion rates and higher sales cycle time.

painPoints.title: Sales Workflow Fragmentation
painPoints.why: Multiple disconnected tools cause data silos.

painPoints.title: Manual Reporting
painPoints.why: Report generation requires manual data extraction.
painPoints.impact: Slower decision making and higher operational cost.
